description: Set up or rotate signed-intent posting for an endpoint. Inputs: an optional header the signature rides in, and projectId plus endpointId. A high-entropy signing key is generated LOCALLY, stored in the CLI keystore, and registered with the server in one atomic step, so the key value never appears in this conversation. Afterwards post_intent signs automatically and the endpoint refuses an unsigned post with a 401 and never stores its payload. Re-running ROTATES the key, and anything still signing with the old one breaks at that moment. Read-write token.

endpointId.description: Opaque endpoint id; omit to use the claimed or only endpoint.

header.description: HTTP header the signature rides in (default X-Flurry-Signature).

projectId.description: Opaque project id; omit to use the claimed or only project.

name: set_endpoint_signing
title: Set endpoint signing
